meta.note: The repository is in its design phase and holds no styles or components: vocabulary and copy come from its docs; colors, type, spacing and components were chosen with the owner (bold & athletic, electric lime, light first, Barlow, medium corners, French copy).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the Set rows and input cells.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: empty input cells, progress tracks, the RPE scale rail.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the big numbers, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: last-session values, captions, meta lines, on every surface (≥6:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Planned values pre-filled in an empty cell and placeholders, on surface and surface-raised only (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and unselected chips (≥3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The brand accent as a FILL: primary button, today's session, a weight increase. Never as text or a line on a light surface (1.2:1); always carry on-lime text.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime and on lime-soft in light (14.5:1).

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as text or icon: an increase delta, the Validated tick, links. On surface, surface-raised and lime-soft (≥7:1).

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a weight increase or a new PR; text on it is ink or lime-ink.

tokens.name: contrast
tokens.usage: Inverted block: selected chip, the session header slab, snackbar.

tokens.name: on-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on contrast (16.9:1).

tokens.name: contrast-track
tokens.usage: Progress track on a contrast slab (the session header): the unfilled part, ≥3:1 against contrast-fill.

tokens.name: contrast-fill
tokens.usage: Progress fill on a contrast slab: lime in light, on-contrast in dark (lime on the light slab would read 1.1:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / accessibility focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; ≥6.7:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets (Set entry, Problem Report): dims the screen, never carries content.

tokens.name: strength
tokens.usage: Training Goal Strength (Force) as a fill: violet, goal badge, chart series. Always with its label.

tokens.name: on-strength
tokens.usage: Text on strength (≥5.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: strength-ink
tokens.usage: Strength as text or icon on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥7.7:1).

tokens.name: hypertrophy
tokens.usage: Training Goal Hypertrophy (Hypertrophie) as a fill: raspberry. Always with its label.

tokens.name: on-hypertrophy
tokens.usage: Text on hypertrophy (≥5.4:1).

tokens.name: hypertrophy-ink
tokens.usage: Hypertrophy as text or icon on surface and surface-raised (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: endurance
tokens.usage: Training Goal Endurance as a fill. Always with its label.

tokens.name: on-endurance
tokens.usage: Text on endurance (12:1).

tokens.name: endurance-ink
tokens.usage: Endurance as text or icon on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure, Missed Session, a weight decrease, destructive buttons, as a fill. Always paired with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger (≥6.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger as text or icon: a decrease delta, an error message, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A Guardrail clamped Gemini's value, or a Problem Report is attached, as a fill.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning (10.4:1).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning as text or icon on surface and surface-raised.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen: the next weight on the session screen, a PR on the dashboard. Uppercase units.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Exercise name at the top of an Exercise card, uppercase.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Planned weight × reps inside cards and Set rows; section headings.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Small numerals: an exercise's position in a list, compact counters.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Overlines, field labels, badge text, button text. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: On monte la charge : toutes les séries ont atteint 5 reps.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text, list rows, inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Exercise names in lists, emphasised values in body text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, chart footnotes, RPE meanings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between cells of a Set row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of input cells and Set rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to the title; above the primary action.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large breaks: the hero number's top margin.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thin bars and small marks: progress tracks and fills, calendar session marks, the sheet grabber.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, input cells, RPE steps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and Set rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the session header slab.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Fully rounded: the navigation bar's selected-tab pill.

size.note: Hit targets sized for sweaty hands between sets.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the primary action (Valider la séance) and of input cells in a Set row.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, list rows and the navigation bar.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in header buttons and steppers (inside a tap-min target).

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: cards sit on surface with a line border. One shadow, for things floating over content.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (RPE picker, Problem Report) and the sticky validate bar.

opacity.note: The two state opacities from Visual foundations › States.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Overlay of ink on a pressed fill.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control; never the only signal that it is disabled.
